title: On divergences in a four-derivative scalar field theory

equations_transcribed.quartic_vertex: V4(p1,p2,p3,p4)=(p1 dot p2)*(p3 dot p4)+(p1 dot p3)*(p2 dot p4)+(p1 dot p4)*(p2 dot p3)

source_statements: The cubic vertex scales quadratically with each external momentum.
The analogous property fails for V4, which scales linearly with each momentum.
The all-order off-shell Euclidean infrared-finiteness theorem uses at least linear scaling from every adjacent soft leg.
transcription_boundary: This record imports the continuum vertex formula and soft-degree statement used to cross-check the independently derived lattice quartic kernel. It does not prove the lattice open-box theorem, a complete order-g^4 score coefficient, a nonperturbative Gibbs bound, or a continuum limit.
